semantics.reset: Asynchronous active-high areset sets state A, as explicitly specified
semantics.clock: State transitions occur at positive clk edges, as explicitly specified
semantics.output: Mealy combinational output uses current state and current x; no output register or added latency
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; verification establishes state through asynchronous reset

numeric.arithmetic: No numeric arithmetic; bitwise output inversion in B

verification.oracle: Independent boolean history model from original transitions: after reset no one has been sampled; once x=1 is sampled at a positive edge state remains B until reset
verification.sampling: Check combinational outputs before edges and after NBA settling; change x away from positive edges
verification.cases: Both inputs in both states, A to B transition pre/post edge, repeated B cycles, between-edge x changes, off-edge reset assertion and release, reset held over positive edges
verification.completion: Bounded timeout, fatal mismatches, PASS line only on success; use fixed dev_check.py

specification_ambiguities: Power-up state before first reset and behavior of illegal one-hot states or unknown inputs are unspecified; no required values are asserted for these cases.
